title: Stop the classification path inventing a second clock in a different timezone
objective: PR #99 made coverage_signal_context's `now` REQUIRED after a Level-2 found it inventing datetime.now(UTC) while its sibling currency_context required one, letting a router build one response payload from two moments with the suite green. This slice audits the whole defect class, classifies every site as ENTRY POINT or PARTICIPANT, converts the participants on the classification chain, and leaves the genuine boundaries alone with written reasons.

census_owned_by_this_slice.method: AST, not source pattern. A regex cannot see a signature a formatter split across lines, cannot distinguish a DEFAULT of None from a COMPARISON against None, and only finds spellings already thought of.
census_owned_by_this_slice.population_defect_census: 170 tracked files under apps/, of which 104 are Python and were parsed; 66 are TypeScript (apps/web) and were NOT searched.
census_owned_by_this_slice.population_blast_radius: 237 tracked .py repo-wide. Deliberately a different population from the defect census because the test tree is NOT under apps/ (0 of 104 match */tests/* or test_*), and the callers that pay the cost of a required parameter live in tests/.
census_owned_by_this_slice.the_ninth_site: apps/api/app/classify/engine.py:151 `as_of = as_of or date.today()`. Invisible to a `now or datetime.now(UTC)` search three ways at once: the parameter is `as_of` not `now`, the type is `date` not `datetime`, and the invention is `date.today()` -- which is LOCAL time while every other clock in this repository is UTC.
census_owned_by_this_slice.floor_not_total: 9 is a FLOOR. It is the count for the nine clock-ish parameter names and seven invention forms actually searched. A tenth in a spelling neither the brief nor this census enumerated remains possible.

ENTRY_POINT_change_nothing: adviser/abuse/admin.py::set_kill_switch -- sole caller is the argparse CLI main(); an operator has no moment to pass, and each command is a single self-contained write with no sibling clock-consumer to disagree with. Comment added; behaviour unchanged.

ingest/reconcile_coverage.py::assert_no_coverage_contradictions -- a test-assertion boundary invoked directly by a provider slice's own test. Sources the clock on an explicit line rather than through an optional parameter, precisely so it does not re-create the hazard.
PARTICIPANT_converted: classify/orm.py::classify_offer (as_of required; was a RELOCATOR -- forwarded None to the callee that invented)
classification.CALL_SITE_defect_fixed: publish/publisher.py::_do_publish already held a UTC `now` (used at :369, :378, :447) and called classify_offer(offer, version) without it, dropping the classification to local date.today(). Now passes as_of=now.date(). Zero signature change, zero test churn.
DEFERRED_with_reasons: read_api/search.py::search_published_offers -- public read surface, 0 production cost, 5 test call sites. Deferred only to keep this slice one causal chain.
publish/publisher.py::publish_candidate -- 0 production cost, 14 test call sites; belongs with the scan-run slice.

ingest/reconcile.py::reconcile_scan and publish/publisher.py::publish_scan -- these invent SEPARATELY inside one run_provider_scans, so a single scan run uses two moments. A real second finding that needs its own evidence, not a tail added to this one. 26 test call sites for reconcile_scan alone.

defect_found_in_the_merged_PR_99_remedy.what: coverage_signal_context's docstring states 'Both production callers already pass a clock, so requiring it costs nothing and removes the capability.' That is true of ARITY and false of NULLABILITY.
defect_found_in_the_merged_PR_99_remedy.how: find_coverage_mismatches forwarded `now=None` into it, satisfying 'must be supplied' while supplying None, and reconcile_coverage.py:183 (inside assert_no_coverage_contradictions) called find_coverage_mismatches(session) with no clock at all. There is no static type checker on the Python side of this repository, so `now: datetime` caught nothing.
defect_found_in_the_merged_PR_99_remedy.measured_behaviour: It does NOT fail open. assess_staleness(fetched_at, None, schedule) raises TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for -: 'NoneType' and 'datetime.datetime'. It stayed invisible only because the data reaching that helper never includes a snapshot with a fetched_at. A LATENT CRASH waiting for the first Wave-3 provider slice with real evidence, not a defect the suite had ruled out.
defect_found_in_the_merged_PR_99_remedy.corroboration: Independently confirmed by mutation: dropping the clock at reconcile_coverage.py:138 killed 4 named integration tests with that exact TypeError at reconcile.py:271.

measured_correction_to_this_slices_own_c.claim_as_first_written: An offer whose available_until fell in the gap was published as free while its own timestamp said the window had closed.
measured_correction_to_this_slices_own_c.measurement: FALSE. A non-null available_until yields Z2_TEMPORARY_OR_CONDITIONAL on BOTH sides of the boundary; as_of never flips the zero-cost class. Verified by executing classify() at as_of=2029-06-01 and as_of=2030-06-01 against identical facts.
measured_correction_to_this_slices_own_c.corrected_claim: as_of changes the published REASON, not the class. The same facts produce either 'Offer availability ended on 2029-12-31.' or 'Offer has a bounded availability window ending 2029-12-31.' The second states that a closed window is still open. A false sentence is a smaller defect than a false class, and still one this product does not ship.
measured_correction_to_this_slices_own_c.where_corrected: The engine.py docstring and the publisher.py comment were rewritten BEFORE commit. A test now asserts the class does NOT move, so if that ever changes, this audit's own conclusion fails loudly rather than silently becoming an understatement.

in_scope: Convert the seven participants above to a required clock.
Fix the _do_publish call site so one publication decision uses one moment.
Add tests/unit/test_clock_inheritance.py asserting the CAPABILITY (no call site can omit a clock) plus a source-level guard against the fallback shape returning under a different parameter name.
Comment the genuine entry points so a later sweep of this defect class stops there deliberately rather than by accident.
out_of_scope_zero_diff: Any change to WHAT is published, as opposed to WHICH MOMENT is used. All 154 failures produced by the signature changes were `TypeError: missing 1 required keyword-only argument` -- arity, never a wrong answer.
apps/web (TypeScript). Not searched, not claimed clean.

security_privacy_portability_z0: No new dependency, no schema change, no migration, no new mandatory service. PostgreSQL remains the only mandatory stateful service. No secret in source, log, commit or PR body. No user-controlled URL. No LLM-to-publication path introduced. Z0 classification logic is unchanged in what it decides; only the moment it decides against is now inherited.
hard_rules_acknowledged: npm install/i/update/audit fix NEVER run; this slice touches no JavaScript.

Own PostgreSQL on port 55432 (suite default is 5432), seeded separately; mutation runs used a SEPARATE database (mutdb) inside a SEPARATE detached worktree, so no evidence was ever read from a tree being mutated.
agent-state/progress.md append-only, proven by raw byte-prefix comparison plus a flipped-byte negative control.
Draft PR. Not merged. No feature marked passing.
not_verified: apps/web was not searched for `new Date()`; the census is Python-only and does not claim the TypeScript read surface is clean.

The timezone divergence was demonstrated by executing classify() at two explicit dates, NOT by running the process under a west-of-UTC TZ and observing date.today() disagree with now.date() on this host. The inference follows from date.today() being local while everything else is UTC, but the host-level divergence itself was not measured.
The deferred scan-run finding (reconcile_scan and publish_scan inventing separately inside one run_provider_scans) is REPORTED, not fixed and not proven by mutation.
evaluator_disposition: PENDING - the builder does not self-certify. Draft PR awaits independent Level-2 review.
